title: Read-only Models & compute panel in the orchestrator GUI
summary: Roadmap 'Observability / UI', first slice. model_view.build aggregates local state only: registered providers with their profiles (deployment, refusal profile, roles), the Research Radar catalog (top by downloads plus abliterated hints), the cached RunPod inventory (never a live fetch on page open; `orchestrate compute inventory` refreshes it), recent throughput measurements, eval-queue status counts and recent entries, refusal telemetry and shadow-foreman aggregates. GET /api/model-compute serves it behind the existing session token and loopback Host check; a collapsible 'Models & compute' panel in Simple Mode renders it lazily on open, with empty-state guidance naming the command that fills each table and a badge for models waiting to be evaluated. No POST route, no model call, no network call, no spend, no routing change. Stop/cancel buttons for paid compute and quote forms wait for the provisioning slice.
